what: Hovering over a photo makes the cursor spot swell like a lens. The swollen spot follows the cursor 10% per frame, and the strength sets its target at 6% on the way in and 12% on the way out, then follows 8% more slowly, so it fills slowly and subsides slowly. The photo fits the cell with cover.
ease: Approaches by a ratio each frame (lerp .1 · .06/.12 · .08)

options.falloff: Falloff 1/(1 + distance² × this value) — the larger it is, the narrower the swelling area, default 8
options.follow: Rate of following the cursor position (per frame), default .1
options.rise: Target approach strength on entering, default .06
options.sink: Target strength approach on exit, default .12
options.lag: Ratio at which the actual intensity follows the target, default .08
options.[data-fx-part=source]: Photo to inflate — img, canvas or video (child, required). It uses WebGL, so only same-origin images work (an img on file:// is blocked)

note: Not applied on touch devices (hover false) — the original also only watches mouse movement. Drawing alone pauses when offscreen

from.where: shared.js SH.bulge (three menu backdrop photos · work detail photo row — original HoverBulge: OGL Renderer·Triangle, falloff 1/(1+d²·8), lerp .1, strength .06/.12 → .08 → ×.25)
